purpose: Teach: 村井/多田/若林/上原/河合/石橋/西口/望月

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、村井刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Murai's handling at the crime scene is being recognized, isn't it?
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Light, conversational — acknowledging competence without fanfare. Warm respect, easy confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人多田氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're gathering careful statements from witness Tada, aren't you?
lines.style: Steady, methodical. The rhythm of procedure. Attentive — checking in as a colleague, not questioning. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者若林氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: You're being considerate with the victim Wakabayashi's family, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle shift downward. Slower pace. Recognizes the human weight of the work. Respectful, knowing nod.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者上原氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: You've secured the witness statement from Uehara, haven't you?
lines.style: Back to procedural rhythm. Clear, organized. The check-mark satisfaction of a step completed. Still warm underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者河合の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: You're checking Kawai's prior record, aren't you?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. The next logical piece. No drama — just thorough work. Conversational confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の石橋から落下事故を、警察、検証されますね
lines.en: You're investigating the fall accident at the bridge at the scene, aren't you?
lines.style: Slight lean forward in the voice. Technical attention. Careful — this is the crux. Still collegial, not directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、駅の西口での盗難事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: You're looking into the theft case at the station's west exit, aren't you?
lines.style: Back to steady pace. Related but separate. The accumulation of details. Organized, supportive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の望月様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you'll be meeting with prosecutor Mochizuki for the pre-trial conference too, won't you?
lines.style: Warmer, almost affectionate. The acknowledgment of a full day ahead. A touch of friendly humor in the efficiency. Close enough to tease gently.
